steps.title: Extract Protein from Cultured Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare protein lysates from adherent cell cultures.

substeps.instruction: Culture cells in dishes until 80% confluency.
Place dish on ice and rinse cells with ice-cold PBS buffer (10 mM Na2HPO4, 1.8 mM Na2H2PO4, 0.2% Tween 20; pH 7.4).
Aspirate PBS and add ice-cold lysis buffer (150 mM NaCl, 1% NP-40, 50 mM Tris-HCl, and protease inhibitors).
Gently scrape adherent cells using a cold plastic cell scraper or digest with 0.05% trypsin followed by PBS wash.
Remove supernatant and wash twice with ice-cold PBS buffer (Boster Bio AR0030).
Transfer cell precipitate into an ice-cold tube.
Add Mammalian Cell Protein Extraction Reagent (Boster Bio AR0103) at a v/v ratio of 6:1 (reagent:precipitate) and resuspend vigorously.
If the solution is murky, sonicate for 10-15 seconds.
Lyse cells in RIPA lysis buffer (Boster Bio AR0105) on ice for 4-5 hours.
Sonicate and lyse again if the solution remains murky.
Centrifuge at ~10,000 rpm at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Discard the lipid layer (top) and cell debris (bottom) by aliquotting the middle solution into a fresh tube; store at -20°C.

steps.title: Extract Protein from Tissues
steps.instruction: Prepare protein lysates from surgically resected tissues.

substeps.instruction: Place resected tissues in pre-cooled (4°C) normal saline and wash off blood.
Cut tissue into small pieces (0.1 g to 1 g each).
Add Broad Spectrum Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (Boster Bio AR1182).
Add 10 mL Mammal Tissue Protein Extraction Reagent (Boster Bio AR0101) per 1 g of tissue.
Mince tissue and place in a tissue homogenizer.
Add ice-cold lysis buffer (e.g., 300 µL buffer for a 5 mg piece of tissue).
Lyse tissue homogenate on ice for 4-5 hours or at 4°C (high speed) for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at ~10,000 rpm at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Discard the lipid layer (top) and cell debris (bottom) by aliquotting the middle solution into a fresh tube; store at -20°C.

steps.title: Determine Protein Concentration (BCA Assay)
steps.instruction: Quantify protein concentration using the BCA Protein Assay Kit (Boster Bio AR0146 or AR1110).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 3,000 rpm at 4°C for 2-3 min.
Reconstitute BSA standard ampules with 0.9% NaCl or PBS to create a 2000 µg/mL working solution (Tube A).
Mix 50 mL BCA Reagent A with 1 mL BCA Reagent B (Diluent).

Prepare diluted BSA standards (Tubes A-I) by mixing diluent and BSA: A (0µL dil/600µL BSA: 2000µg/mL), B (100µL dil/300µL BSA: 1500µg/mL), C (300µL dil/300µL BSA: 1000µg/mL), D (200µL Tube B/200µL BSA: 750µg/mL), E (300µL Tube C/300µL BSA: 500µg/mL), F (300µL Tube E/300µL BSA: 250µg/mL), G (300µL Tube F/300µL BSA: 125µg/mL), H (400µL Tube G/100µL BSA: 25µg/mL), I (300µL dil/0µL BSA: 0µg/mL).
Pipette 0.1 mL of each standard and unknown sample replicate into labeled tubes.
Add 2.0 mL of working range (WR) to each tube and mix well.
Incubate tubes using one of three protocols: Standard (37°C, 30 min), RT (Room Temp, 2 hours), or Enhanced (60°C, 30 min). Use a water bath for 37°C/60°C.
Cool all tubes to room temperature.
Zero spectrophotometer at 562 nm with water; measure absorbance of all samples within 10 minutes.
Subtract average blank absorbance from all other replicates.
Plot a standard curve (blank-corrected 562 nm measurement vs. concentration in µg/mL) to determine unknown protein concentrations.

steps.title: Prepare SDS-PAGE Gel
steps.instruction: Cast a gel based on the target protein's molecular weight.

substeps.instruction: Select gel percentage: >200kDa (6%), 15-200kDa (8%), 10-70kDa (10%), 12-45kDa (12%), 4-40kDa (20%). Use SDS-PAGE Gel Preparation Kit (Boster Bio AR0138) or pre-cast gels.
Mix resolving gel ingredients, pour into casting form, and layer the top with distilled water.
Wait ~30 minutes for polymerization, then remove water with a paper towel.
Mix stacking gel ingredients and pour on top of the resolving gel.
Insert sample comb (avoid bubbles) and allow 30-60 minutes for polymerization.

steps.title: Prepare and Load Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Denature proteins and load them onto the gel.

substeps.instruction: Mix extracted protein sample with 4X Dual Color Protein Loading Buffer (Boster Bio AR1142) at a 3:1 ratio (e.g., 300µg sample to 100µL buffer).
Denature the mixture in a 100°C water bath for 5 minutes.
Place gel in electrophoresis apparatus and fill chambers with SDS-PAGE Electrophoresis Buffer (25 mM Tris base, 190 mM glycine, 0.1% SDS; pH 8.3; Boster Bio AR0139).
Remove comb and rinse wells with electrophoresis buffer.
Quickly pipette samples into wells (e.g., 20-25 µL of 1 µg/µL sample for a 30 µL max well).
Pipette 10 µL of controls or molecular weight standards into separate wells.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by size using an electric current.

substeps.instruction: Connect anode and cathode correctly.
Run electrophoresis at 100V/130V until bromophenol blue dye reaches the gel bottom (1.5 to 3 hours).
Turn off power once samples have finished migrating.
Optional: Use gel staining (Boster Bio AR0140, AR0170, or AR0171) to verify separation (note: stained gels cannot be used for transfer).

steps.title: Transfer Proteins to Membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer separated proteins from the gel to a NC or PVDF membrane.

substeps.instruction: Cut blotting membrane to gel size and mark orientation.
Immerse membrane in 1X transfer buffer (25 mM Tris base, 190 mM glycine, 20% methanol; pH 8.3; Boster Bio AR1149) for 5 minutes while rocking.
Soak two filter papers in 1X transfer buffer.
Cut gel to membrane size and mark the lane #1 corner; immerse gel in 1X transfer buffer for 15-30 minutes.
Assemble the transfer sandwich in the cassette: Foam Pad → Filter Paper → Gel → Membrane → Filter Paper → Foam Pad (use Boster Bio AR0172 or AR0173 pads).
Roll out air bubbles from the membrane using a pipette or tube.
Lock the cassette and immerse it in a tank filled with 1X transfer buffer.
Ensure the gel is closer to the cathode and the membrane is closer to the anode.
Operate at constant voltage of 25 V for 30 minutes (or 10 V overnight).
Optional: Check efficiency with Ponceau S (0.2% w/v Ponceau S; 5% glacial acetic acid) or Boster Bio AR0142 for 5-10 minutes.

steps.title: Block and Incubate with Antibodies
steps.instruction: Block non-specific sites and bind target proteins with antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Rinse membrane 3X with TBS Wash Buffer (20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% Tween 20; Boster Bio AR0144) for 10 minutes each.
Immerse membrane in TBS Blocking Buffer (5% non-fat dry milk in 20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl; Boster Bio AR0143) for 1.5-2 hours at RT or overnight at 4°C with shaking.
Dilute primary antibody in TBS Wash Buffer (AR0144) and incubate with membrane at 4°C overnight or 1-2 hours at RT.
Wash membrane 3X with TBS Wash Buffer (AR0144) for 10 minutes each.
Dilute secondary antibody in TBS Blocking Buffer (AR0143) and incubate at 4°C overnight or 1-2 hours at RT on a shaker.
Wash membrane 3X with TBS Wash Buffer for 10 minutes each.
Prepare ECL substrate: mix 50 µL 20X Chromogenic Reagent A, 50 µL 20X Chromogenic Reagent B, and 1 mL distilled water; use within 2 hours.
Cover membrane with substrate (1 mL per 10 cm²).
Incubate at RT until bands appear (usually 1-5 minutes).
Blot edges of membrane with paper to remove excess solution.
Place a clear preservative film or transparent glass paper over the membrane, removing air bubbles.

Develop and fix film using WB Developing Fixing Kit (Boster Bio AR0132): immerse in developing solution for 10 seconds to 10 minutes, wash with clean water, immerse in fixing solution for 3-5 minutes, and wash again with water.
Optional: Use WB Stripping Buffer (Boster Bio AR0153) to remove antibodies for reuse.

steps.title: Detect Proteins via DAB or BCIP/NBT

substeps.instruction: Prepare DAB substrate: mix 50 µL 40X Chromogenic Reagent A (DAB), 50 µL 40X Chromogenic Reagent B (H2O2), 50 µL 40X Chromogenic Reagent C (TBS Wash Buffer), and 2 mL distilled water.
OR Prepare BCIP/NBT substrate: mix 50 µL 20X Chromogenic Reagent A (BCIP/NBT), 50 µL 20X Chromogenic Reagent B (Tris buffer pH 9.4), and 1 mL distilled water.
Cover membrane with substrate (1 mL per 10 cm²).
Incubate at RT until bands appear (10-30 minutes); BCIP/NBT must be incubated in the dark.
Wash membrane in distilled water to stop the reaction and take pictures.
